description: Companion dataset for the Extended Data cross-domain validation experiments of the MAVERICK paper. Four sources (US legal, CN legal, US clinical, CN clinical), each N=100 with 50 genuine / 30 manipulated / 20 in-the-wild, gold-standard verified programmatically via authoritative primary-key lookup.

category.genuine: verified genuine record (primary key hits authoritative registry)

category.in_the_wild: synthetic-wild hallucinated record (primary key not found -> false)
